name: Hinkelsteinwiese
beschreibung: The Hinkelsteinwiese is one of the ten camping meadows of the Tiroler Pfadfinderzentrum Igls (TPZ) in Igls, a district of Innsbruck (postal code 6080). The site lies above Innsbruck in the Heiligwasser/Patscherkofel area. The centre is used primarily by scout and youth groups, associations and for events. Camping guests can use the outdoor sanitary facilities with twelve washbasins, eight showers and four separate washrooms. On site there are fire pits, barbecue barrels as well as rental of tables, benches and building material for camp constructions. According to the official price list, an overnight stay at the campsite costs seven euros per person per night plus tourist tax; an electricity connection is only possible after consultation with the administration. The main house additionally offers rooms.
